name: tsc-ts
description: The TypeScript 7 compiler, ported to TypeScript and compiled to a native executable.

scripts.build: tsc --outDir dist --rootDir .. --target es2024 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --strict --skipLibCheck --types node src/main.ts
scripts.generate: node scripts/generate.mjs && node scripts/generate-diagnostics.mjs && node scripts/generate-ast.mjs
